_meta.description: Sector-weighted composition of Latam equity indices (COLCAP, Merval) for use as the country-specific equity beta in our WACC model.
_meta.data_status: ESTIMATED_FROM_PUBLIC_SOURCES — see notes per index. Not live market data. To refresh, run scripts/refresh_index_composition.py locally with browser access.
